audit: Every source segment on a first run of the benchmark of 2026-09-27 that the merge does not carry word for word and wrote no record for, and every segment the registered scoring counted as silent loss on a repeated run, each read with the merged document of its run and classed by what became of its content.

classes.gone: The fact or instruction is nowhere in the merged document.
classes.partly: Part of it is in the merged document and part is gone.
classes.present: The merged document states it: in other words, split, or joined onto another sentence.
classes.not_content: A heading whose section is in the merged document under another heading, or the like.

groups.counted_missing: A segment the registered scoring counted as silent loss: its text is not in the merge word for word, no record of the merge names it, and no single merge segment is at least 0.68 similar to it. Every run that has one, repeats included.
groups.reworded_no_record: A segment on a first run that the registered similarity rule alone called reworded and that no record of the merge names: a merge segment is at least 0.68 similar to it, and its words do not stand in the merge as one unbroken run. First runs only.

counted_missing.first: One run of an AI model (Claude Opus), given each counted segment and the merged document of its run. All 65 cases, every run.
counted_missing.second: A separate run of the same model, given the 25 first-run cases and the merged documents and nothing else: not the first reading's classes, not the program's scores, not the benchmark's figures.

reworded_no_record.first: Reading A: a separate run of the same model, given the 19 segments with the source documents and the merged documents of their runs and nothing else. reworded_no_record.second: Reading B: another separate run of the same model, given the same and nothing else, and not given reading A.
